notes: Adds an owner-only Poseidon publication control below connection refresh. The button appears after a real local source write, survives extension update/reload through persistent storage, publishes source to jeep-jim/OSMINOG and the release/feed to jeep-jim/OSMINOG-Releases, and clears only after success. A compact confirmed cancel clears the pending marker without deleting local files. The visible toggle is renamed from Poseidon Source to Poseidon.
